text.text_excerpt: I love Van's. IMHO Van's is the best snowball stand on the westbank. They've been there since I was a little kid (I'm 32 now) and when I lived in Algiers Van's was my special treat. The building is a cute little striped stand. The staff is super sweet. Soft ice which they make themselves. A variety of flavors including sugar free and cream flavors. My personal favorite is the cantaloupe. They are open to experimentation and will let you mix or stripe your 'ball. They will customise the juiciness just ask! They have a gravel parking lot so no worries about street parking. The snow ball stand exploration continues! This time we decided to check out an old Algiers favorite: Van's. Van's is probably the oldest snowball stand on the Westbank. They have been serving the sweet stuff since the 70's, they have every flavor under the sun and they have extra goodies like nachos and hot dogs. I got my usual rainbow (I know that sounds boring, but every stand has a different version) and David got Dream Cream (ehh...). Mine was great! It had a lot of flavor without being overly sweet and I finished more than half of my medium/$2.50 snowball. David liked the Dream Cream, so we both left satisfied. Love Van's!!! I've lived on the Westbank my whole life and Van's has been my #1 snowball place since the beginning. The ice has a good consistency and there's soooo many great flavors to choose from. My favorites are ice cream and wedding cake but I've tried just about everything and I love it all. Whenever I need my snowball fix, this is my place!
